rules.description: Every object must have exactly one primary kind from the allowed kind set.
Object IDs must be unique within a bundle.
All relation targets must exist and satisfy the required target-kind constraints.
TaskSpecification must reference exactly one ValidationSpecification via hasValidationSpecification.
DependencyRelation must contain exactly one source task, one target task, one dependency kind, and source must not equal target.
RoleAssignment must include assignsAgent, assignsRole, and assignmentScopePlan relations.
ValidationSpecification must include validationMethod and passCondition attributes and must expect at least one EvidenceRecord.
TaskExecutionRecord must reference one TaskSpecification and one TaskExecutionActivity.
Execution-bearing records with status IS must include evidence_refs.
Status must be one of IS, OUGHT, UNKNOWN.
